senses.gloss:
जिगीषा [जि-सन् भावे अ]
1 Desire
of conquering, subduing or
overcoming; यानं सस्मार कौबेरं वैवस्वत
जिगीषया R. 15. 45.
--2 Emulation,
rivalry.
--3 Eminence.
--4 Exertion,
profession, habit of life.
--5
Eminence.
--6 Military ardour, warlike
spirit.

जिगीषु a.
1 Desirous of
conquering.
--2 Vying or contending with.
